items.title: Jackie Cain and Roy Kral interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, March 22, 1998
items.q: That wasn’t Steve Allen though, honey. Just some other tune that he thought would be a hit.

ctx.x: Broaden your audience. Okay. We said fine, all right, great. So among other things he gave us one song, he says, “you’ve got to do this.” And it was a song written by Steve Allen called “Pa Take Me to the Circus” built on an old polka melody.
That wasn’t Steve Allen though, honey. Just some other tune that he thought would be a hit.

[humms] In my home town, Czechoslovakian, it’s called “barushka” polka. But this was something else. And we said okay. So we recorded these four things. And later we got home and we sat down and thought about what we did, and actually jumped up in the air in total horror and panic, thinking, what if it becomes popular.
